name: CalFresh
next_step: Ask your county or campus CalFresh navigator to review your household and student rules, then apply through BenefitsCal.

name: Medi-Cal
description: Free or low-cost California health coverage for people who meet program rules.
next_step: Use the official Medi-Cal site to check current requirements and application options.

name: Cal Grant
description: California student aid for qualifying undergraduate, vocational, and some teacher credential students.
next_step: Ask financial aid about FAFSA or California Dream Act application requirements, GPA submission, and current deadlines.

name: California College Promise Grant
description: An enrollment-fee waiver for eligible California community college students.
next_step: Contact your community college financial aid office about applying through FAFSA, CADAA, or the separate grant application.

name: Campus basic-needs support
description: Campus referrals for food, housing, and other basic needs. Services and funding vary by college.
next_step: Contact your college's basic-needs or student-support office. Ask about food access, housing referrals, emergency support, and student-parent resources; availability is campus-specific.

name: Federal Pell Grant
description: Federal grant aid generally for eligible undergraduate students with financial need.
next_step: Review federal eligibility and submit FAFSA if applicable. Your financial aid office determines your award.
